intro: Krog looks over the Blackened Iron Shield and sees nothing unusual about it. Krog suggests that the blacksmith Do'gol inspect it, though without much hope, and sends you to Brackenwall Village.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Hmm... I don't see anything out of the ordinary with this shield. We should have Do'gol, the blacksmith, take a look at it, and see if he can tell us more about it, but I wouldn't hold out hope...

clips.title: Completion
paras: This is good shield. Very strong, heavy, good. But Do'gol don't need it. I make shields, not buy them, friend.
